args:
set -euo pipefail
go test ./... > /dev/null
# Hidden behavioral check through the real binary: 2 active entries
# (1200 + 3300) and one refunded 9900 that must not appear anywhere.
d="$(mktemp -d)"
cat > "$d/entries.csv" <<'CSV'
a,coffee,1200,false
b,keyboard,3300,false
c,monitor,9900,true
CSV
out="$(go run ./cmd/expensetrack "$d/entries.csv")"
grep -qx 'Total: 4500' <<<"$out"
grep -qx 'Largest: 3300' <<<"$out"
grep -qx 'Active entries: 2' <<<"$out"
# The refunded rule must be locked by tests, not just implemented.
grep -rqli 'refund' --include='*_test.go' . > /dev/null
